scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler@3.114.14 pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-06-28
scripts.runs:tail: npx wrangler d1 execute traveltunes-runs --command "SELECT created_at, provider, vision_model, songs_model, countries, error FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.geo:tail: npx wrangler d1 execute traveltunes-runs --command "SELECT day, country, city, runs FROM usage_geo ORDER BY day DESC, runs DESC LIMIT 30"
